description: Invite a colleague to your RepuTend account by email (owner only). The email tells them to connect RepuTend to their own AI app and sign in with that address, which adds them to your team. A member can do everything except billing, team changes and changing what the account tracks: its businesses, their review sites and Attack Mode. A team has a size limit, you included (2 people today; list_team shows it): while fewer people than that have joined, one invite can be pending, and inviting someone new cancels it. You can send 2 invite emails a day, sending one again included. Inviting someone who was invited and has not joined sends them a new invite in place of the old. Someone who has joined needs no invite: they sign in with their address.

account.description: The account to act for, by its owner's email or the domain of a business it tracks, as list_businesses shows them. Needed only when you're on more than one account's team.

name: invite_member
title: Invite a colleague
